compose.title.new.description: The title of the post composer when it writes a new post.

compose.title.reply.description: The title of the post composer when it writes a reply to a post.

compose.title.quote.description: The title of the post composer when it writes a post that quotes another.

compose.close.description: The button at the end of the composer's head that leaves it; a written post is discarded, with Undo.

compose.post.description: The composer's primary button, which posts what is written.

compose.text.placeholder.description: The placeholder of the composer's empty text.

compose.text.label.description: The name of the composer's text field, for assistive technology.

compose.cw.label.description: The name of the content warning field, for assistive technology.

compose.cw.placeholder.defaultMessage: What the reader is warned of
compose.cw.placeholder.description: The placeholder of the content warning field: the warning readers see before they open the post.

compose.cw.on.description: The tool of the composer's row that adds a content warning field.

compose.cw.off.description: The same tool while the post has a content warning: it removes it.

compose.attach.description: The tool of the composer's row that opens the file picker to attach images (or a video or an audio file).

compose.poll.on.description: The tool of the composer's row that adds a poll to the post.

compose.poll.off.description: The same tool while the post has a poll, and the remove of the poll's card.

compose.poll.option.description: The placeholder and the name of a poll's option. n is its place, from 1.

compose.poll.remove_option.description: The button at the end of a poll's option that takes it out. n is its place, from 1.

compose.poll.add.description: The last line of a poll's options, which adds one.

compose.poll.duration.description: The name of the poll's duration choices.

compose.poll.ends_in.description: The poll's duration control, as it reads. duration is one of the choices (5 minutes, 1 day).

compose.poll.minutes.description: A choice of the poll's duration, in minutes; also what the duration control reads.

compose.poll.hours.description: A choice of the poll's duration, in hours.

compose.poll.days.description: A choice of the poll's duration, in days.

compose.poll.multiple.description: The checkbox of the poll that lets a vote choose several options.

compose.poll.hide_totals.defaultMessage: Hide the counts until it ends
compose.poll.hide_totals.description: The checkbox of the poll that hides how many voted for each option until it ends.

compose.poll.invalid.defaultMessage: A poll needs {min} to {max} different options of at most {length} characters each, and must last from 5 minutes to 30 days.
compose.poll.invalid.description: The error before Post when the poll has a blank option or two the same; the server's own words (errors.status.poll_invalid).

compose.audience.description: The caption of the visibility choices in the audience menu, and the name of the menu's tool.

compose.audience.tool.defaultMessage: {visibility, select, public {Who can see it: Public} local {Who can see it: Local} unlisted {Who can see it: Quiet public} private {Who can see it: Followers only} other {Who can see it: Direct}}{limited, select, yes {, replies, boosts or quotes limited} other {}}
compose.audience.tool.description: The name of the audience tool for assistive technology: the post's visibility, and whether who may interact is limited. The visibilities are the post's (Public, Local, Quiet public, Followers only, Direct).

compose.audience.everyone.description: A choice of the permissions submenu: anyone who may see the post.

compose.audience.followers.description: A choice of the permissions submenu: the author's followers and the accounts the post mentions.

compose.audience.mentioned.description: A choice of the permissions submenu: the accounts the post mentions.

compose.audience.nobody.description: A choice of the permissions submenu: the author alone.

compose.visibility.public.description: A visibility in the audience menu; the same word as a post's visibility glyph.

compose.visibility.local.description: A visibility in the audience menu: on this server's local timeline, and to the author's followers elsewhere.

compose.visibility.unlisted.description: A visibility in the audience menu: public, kept out of the public timelines.

compose.visibility.private.description: A visibility in the audience menu: the author's followers and the accounts the post mentions.

compose.visibility.direct.description: A visibility in the audience menu: the accounts the post mentions alone.

compose.visibility.public.about.description: The line under Public in the audience menu: who sees the post.

compose.visibility.local.about.defaultMessage: Everyone on {server}, and your followers elsewhere
compose.visibility.local.about.description: The line under Local in the audience menu. server is this server's domain.

compose.visibility.unlisted.about.defaultMessage: Anyone, kept out of the public timelines
compose.visibility.unlisted.about.description: The line under Quiet public in the audience menu.

compose.visibility.private.about.defaultMessage: Your followers and the people you mention
compose.visibility.private.about.description: The line under Followers only in the audience menu.

compose.visibility.direct.about.description: The line under Direct in the audience menu.

compose.interactions.description: The caption of the audience menu's second group, apart from the visibilities: who may reply to, boost and quote the post.

compose.permissions.defaultMessage: Who can reply, boost and quote
compose.permissions.description: The title of the submenu of who may reply to, boost and quote the post, beside its back button.

compose.permissions.item.description: The item of the audience menu that opens the submenu of who may reply to, boost and quote the post.

compose.permissions.open.defaultMessage: Anyone can reply, boost and quote
compose.permissions.open.description: The line under the permissions item while anyone may reply to, boost and quote the post.

compose.permissions.limited.description: The line under the permissions item while someone may not reply to, boost or quote the post.

compose.interaction.reply.description: The caption of a group of the permissions submenu.

compose.interaction.announce.description: The caption of a group of the permissions submenu.

compose.interaction.quote.description: The caption of a group of the permissions submenu.

compose.language.description: The caption of the language menu of the composer, and the start of its tool's name for assistive technology.

compose.language.tool.description: The name of the composer's language tool for assistive technology. language is the post's language, by its name in its own words.

compose.remaining.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
compose.remaining.description: What the composer's count says to assistive technology while the post is within its limit.

compose.over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character over} other {# characters over}}
compose.over.description: What the composer's count says to assistive technology once the post is past its limit.

compose.too_long.defaultMessage: {max, plural, one {The text and content warning must be at most # character.} other {The text and content warning must be at most # characters.}}
compose.too_long.description: The error under the composer's text once it is past the limit; the server's own words (errors.status.text_too_long).

compose.quote_remote.defaultMessage: A local, followers-only, or direct post cannot quote a post from another server.
compose.quote_remote.description: The note under the visibilities when the post quotes a post from another server; the server's own words (errors.status.quote_remote_audience).

compose.replying_to.description: What the post replied to says to assistive technology, above the composer's text. handle is its author's, as @user@domain.

compose.quote.remove.description: The button on the quoted post in the composer that takes it out of the post.

compose.description.description: The label of an image's description (alternative text) beside it in the composer.

compose.description.hint.defaultMessage: What the image shows, for those who cannot see it
compose.description.hint.description: The placeholder of an image's description in the composer.

compose.description.missing.description: The caution under an image's empty description in the composer.

compose.description.required.defaultMessage: This server requires a description (alt text) for every image. Add one to each image before posting.
compose.description.required.description: The error under an image's empty description when the server asks for one, after Post was pressed; the server's own words (errors.status.missing_media_description).

compose.uploading.description: Beside an image while its file uploads.

compose.processing.description: Beside an image while the server processes the uploaded file.

compose.upload_failed.description: Beside an image whose upload failed, before its retry button.

compose.retry.description: The button that uploads a failed image again.

compose.remove.description: The button at the end of an image's row that takes it out of the post.

compose.wait_uploads.defaultMessage: Wait until every image has uploaded, or remove the ones that failed.
compose.wait_uploads.description: The error before Post when it is pressed while an image uploads or failed to.

compose.poll.description: The caption of the poll's card in the composer.

compose.failed.defaultMessage: Posting did not finish. Try again.
compose.failed.description: The error before Post when the post got no answer from the server (the network); pressing Post sends it again, once.

compose.discarded.description: The notice at the bottom of the page after the composer was closed with a written post, beside Undo.

compose.undo.description: The action of the discarded post's notice: it opens the composer again with the post.
